text: {"findings":[{"type":"POLICY_REVIEW","title":"Driver bonus lacks required Legal and Compensation review","detail":"A referral bonus is a driver pay incentive, which requires Legal and Compensation review. The proposal records only a legal waiver by VP email with no ticket, and there is no Compensation review. A waiver claim is not a recorded review.","evidence_quote":"Legal review: waived per VP email, no ticket.","citations":["policy-compliance#driver-compensation-and-classification"],"recommendation":"Obtain and link documented Legal and Compensation reviews (ticket IDs) before launch. If a waiver is claimed, attach the formal approval record."}]}
